strings.zh: 把身上的精灵存放在箱子里
strings.en: Pokémon in your party may be stored{NEWLINE}in the storage system’s Boxes.

strings.zh: 把存放在箱子里的精灵带到身上
strings.en: Pokémon stored in Boxes may be added{NEWLINE}to your party.

You may sort the items held by your{NEWLINE}Pokémon in Boxes and in your party.

Up to 20 pieces of Mail can be{NEWLINE}stored.
You may set or edit Capsules for{NEWLINE}decorating Poké Balls.
You may look at pictures you{NEWLINE}have taken on your adventure.

strings.zh: 提升１只精灵的１０物攻努力值。
strings.notes: Hack changed the BP vitamin/Power item/TM descriptions (EV amounts, percentages); 396-432 retranslated from the zh, US wording kept where it still matches.

strings.zh: 提升１只精灵的１０特攻努力值。
strings.en: Raises one Pokémon’s Sp. Atk EVs{NEWLINE}by 10.

strings.zh: 提升１只精灵的１０物防努力值。
提升１只精灵的１０特防努力值。
strings.en: Raises one Pokémon’s Sp. Def EVs{NEWLINE}by 10.

strings.zh: 提升１只精灵的１０速度努力值。
提升１只精灵的１０点ＨＰ努力值

strings.en: It raises the level of a single Pokémon{NEWLINE}by one.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的物攻努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra Attack EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的物防努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra Defense EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的特攻努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra Sp. Atk EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的特防努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra Sp. Def EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的速度努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra Speed EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后精灵获得的ＨＰ努力值+４{NEWLINE}但速度减半。
strings.en: The holder gains 4 extra HP EVs,{NEWLINE}but its Speed is halved.

strings.zh: 携带后在战斗中变为剧毒状态。
strings.en: The holder becomes badly poisoned{NEWLINE}during battle.
strings.notes: US 0191/409 | RV057: addition: US "bizarre orb" not in the zh

strings.zh: 携带后在战斗中变为烧伤状态。
strings.notes: US 0191/410 | RV057: addition: US "bizarre orb" not in the zh

strings.zh: 携带后{NEWLINE}精灵的能力下降时可还原一次。
strings.en: It restores any lowered stat in{NEWLINE}battle. It can be used only once.

strings.zh: 让精灵携带后,需要１回合蓄力{NEWLINE}时间的技能可立刻发动。
strings.en: It allows the immediate use of a move{NEWLINE}that charges on the first turn.

strings.zh: 携带后用光迷惑对手,{NEWLINE}使对手技能命中下降１０％。
strings.en: It casts a tricky glare that lowers{NEWLINE}the foe’s accuracy by 10%.

strings.zh: 携带后物攻１.５倍,{NEWLINE}但只能持续使用一招。
strings.en: The holder’s Attack is boosted 1.5x,{NEWLINE}but it can use only one move.

strings.zh: 携带后受到致命攻击时,{NEWLINE}１０％几率剩下１ＨＰ。
strings.en: The holder has a 10% chance to{NEWLINE}survive a KO attack with 1 HP.

strings.zh: 携带的精灵会心率上升１级。
strings.en: Raises the holder’s critical-hit{NEWLINE}ratio by one stage.

strings.zh: 携带后物理技能威力上升１０％。
strings.en: Boosts the power of the holder’s{NEWLINE}physical moves by 10%.

strings.zh: 携带后在ＨＰ全满时受到致命攻击{NEWLINE}也会以ＨＰ１的状态存活一次。
strings.en: With full HP, the holder will endure{NEWLINE}one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

strings.zh: 携带后速度１.５倍,{NEWLINE}只能持续使用一招。
strings.en: The holder’s Speed is boosted 1.5x,{NEWLINE}but it can use only one move.
Raises the holder’s critical-hit{NEWLINE}ratio by one stage.

strings.zh: 携带后攻击,对手１０％几率害怕
strings.en: When the holder attacks, the foe{NEWLINE}has a 10% chance to flinch.

strings.zh: 以高速行动玩弄对手。{NEWLINE}攻击一定能命中对手。
strings.en: The user confounds the foe with speed.{NEWLINE}This attack never misses.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 用拳头攻击。{NEWLINE}能贯穿光墙和反射壁。
strings.en: Attacks with a fist. It can break{NEWLINE}through Light Screen and Reflect.
strings.notes: US 0191/423 | RV057: omission: hack zh says it attacks with a fist and pierces Light Screen/Reflect (D-1679)

strings.zh: 在攻击对手后,{NEWLINE}自己下场交换。
strings.en: After attacking, the user rushes back{NEWLINE}to switch places with a party Pokémon.

strings.zh: 用镰刀一样的爪子剪切对手。
strings.en: The user shears the foe with its{NEWLINE}scythe-like claws.
strings.notes: US 0191/425 | RV057: meaning: hack zh = scythe-like claws, not crossed claws (D-1679)

strings.zh: 从下方突出尖锐的岩石。{NEWLINE}容易发动会心一击。
strings.en: Sharp rocks jut up from below.{NEWLINE}It has a high critical-hit ratio.
strings.notes: US 0191/426 | RV057: meaning: hack zh = sharp rocks thrust up from below (D-1679)

strings.zh: 制造山摇地动的地震。{NEWLINE}能打中挖洞的敌人并且伤害２倍。
strings.en: Sets off a mighty earthquake. It hits{NEWLINE}a foe using Dig for double damage.

strings.zh: 扔出一团黑影攻击。{NEWLINE}２０％降低１级特防。
strings.en: Hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. Has a{NEWLINE}20% chance to lower Sp. Def by 1 stage.

strings.zh: 释放能量攻击。{NEWLINE}１０％特防下降１级。
strings.en: Fires off gathered energy. Has a 10%{NEWLINE}chance to lower Sp. Def by 1 stage.

strings.zh: 投出肮脏的淤泥。{NEWLINE}３０％陷入中毒状态。
strings.en: Hurls filthy sludge at the foe. It{NEWLINE}has a 30% chance to poison.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 从嘴里吐出强烈的{NEWLINE}冲击波攻击对手。
strings.en: The user spits a powerful shock wave{NEWLINE}from its mouth at the foe.
strings.notes: US 0191/431 | RV057: omission: 强烈的 (powerful) dropped

strings.zh: 让对手陷入剧毒状态。{NEWLINE}随着回合数增长伤害增加。
strings.en: Badly poisons the foe. The damage{NEWLINE}grows worse every turn.

strings.zh: 释放弱电流使对手麻痹。
strings.en: A weak electric charge is launched at{NEWLINE}the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

strings.zh: 放出怪异的蓝色火焰。{NEWLINE}能让对手烧伤。
strings.en: Releases a sinister blue flame.{NEWLINE}It can burn the foe.
strings.notes: US 0191/434 | RV057: meaning: hack zh = blue flame, not bluish-white (D-1679)

strings.zh: ㊚对㊛或㊛对㊚{NEWLINE}进行诱惑使其陷入着迷状态。
strings.en: Seduces a foe of the opposite gender{NEWLINE}to make it infatuated.
strings.notes: US 0191/435 | RV057: addition: US "less likely to attack" not in the hack zh

strings.zh: 集中力量让肌肉收缩,{NEWLINE}物攻和物防上升１级。
strings.en: The user tenses its muscles, raising{NEWLINE}Attack and Defense by 1 stage each.

strings.zh: 集中精神让心平静,{NEWLINE}特攻和特防上升１级。
strings.en: The user calms its mind, raising Sp. Atk{NEWLINE}and Sp. Def by 1 stage each.

strings.zh: 泥土会加速干燥,{NEWLINE}树果的成长速度加快。
strings.en: It speeds up the growth of Berries.{NEWLINE}However, it also dries the soil faster.

strings.zh: 泥土会减慢干燥,{NEWLINE}树果的成长速度减慢。
strings.en: It slows the growth of Berries and{NEWLINE}causes the soil to dry more slowly.

strings.zh: 泥土会减慢干燥,{NEWLINE}树果的成熟时间变长。
strings.en: The soil dries more slowly, and{NEWLINE}Berries take longer to ripen.
strings.notes: US 0191/472 | RV057: omission: zh slower soil drying restored; 成熟时间变长 read as longer to ripen per JP source (おそくなる); settles D-1680

strings.zh: 树果枯萎后{NEWLINE}长出新芽的次数增加。
strings.en: It ups the number of times new plants{NEWLINE}grow where mature plants withered.
